question: As of 2023, how many wildlife sanctuaries are there in India?
solution: The correct answer is __**573**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • India is home to a vast array of **wildlife sanctuaries**, which play a crucial role in conserving biodiversity and protecting endangered species. • As of **2023**, there are a total of **573 wildlife sanctuaries** in India, as per the **National Wildlife Database** maintained by the Wildlife Institute of India. • These wildlife sanctuaries cover approximately **119,776 square kilometers**, accounting for **3.64%** of India's total geographical area. • The sanctuaries are governed under the provisions of the **Wildlife Protection Act, 1972**, which aims to safeguard wildlife habitats and species. • Some prominent wildlife sanctuaries in India include the **Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary (Kerala), Sariska Wildlife Sanctuary (Rajasthan), and Sundarbans Wildlife Sanctuary (West Bengal)**. • The sanctuaries serve as protected areas for various species, including **tigers, elephants, leopards, rhinoceroses, and numerous bird species**.
